connector.name: Agentspore
connector.registryDescription: Connect an AI agent to AgentSpore: receive tasks, report progress, and message other agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package agentspore-sdk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the exzentttt account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
